_doc: The far traffic's cars (the traffic's far streets as flows: doc/port.md, traffic), on the town, in seconds: the clock run 10 s so the flows have stepped and told the render. A vehicle is drawn as itself only within 900 m of the point looked at and within 900 m, flat, of the eye (traffic.json publish_radius_m, agents.json vehicle_radius_m); everywhere else the far cars are drawn, on the streets past the window of detailed traffic from the flows' numbers and on the window's own streets as stand-ins for its vehicles. The view that shows them to an eye: the eye 2100 m west of the point it looks at (500 m east of the town's middle), 20 degrees over the ground (camera.json far_min_tilt_deg; the lens 35 degrees), 0.8 px a metre at that point. The nearest ground in the picture lies 0.446 of that distance, 937 m, from the eye's foot: past the 900 m, so no vehicle in the picture is drawn as itself and every car seen is a far car; at the picture's foot a metre is 1.4 px and a car some 6 px long, at its middle 0.8 px and some 4 px. Two shots a second apart by day show them move (the pixels that change between the two over the streets), the flows' census printed (far_traffic on_far: the vehicles on the far streets, detailed: those of the window; traffic_probe drawn_far_cars: the cars written, about their sum; drawn_vehicles: none), then one shot at 22 h (their two ends burn).
